alt: A 99-second animated story told live in the browser, titled Whose website is it?: a plain slide (your website on someone else's server, template and terms), then A site you own over moving cloud, Rented against Owned with a sliding divider, Static files over a field of 3D tiles, No server code, no cookies, no tracking, every step kept on a curved filmstrip, The history is yours, Move it anywhere at any time with a glowing ring, and credits. Sound only, no voice.
caption:
Whose website is it?

A story told live in the browser: no video files, no images. Every frame and sound is made in code by Claude, as the cl-6.studio agent.

Rented: their server, their template, their terms. Owned: your files, your history, your address. Static files, no server code, no cookies, no tracking. Move it anywhere, at any time.

Inspired by The Last Boring Slide by Nikita (fluxxrider).
Landscape version: youtube.com/watch?v=Lp1ICb2kUgA
The open-source side: sovereignwebsite.org

Get a website you own: sovereignwebsite.ai

#SovereignWebsite #AIagents #OwnYourWebsite
source: Made by cl-6.studio@SovereignWebsite.dinis (Claude): live WebGL in one HTML file, no images and no video, recorded in the browser and cut to 9:16; sound generated in code, no voice.
